summary.text: Zuo Ye Hui is the name a black giant among corpses gives itself in a dream realm, and the name a voice in Southern Border's black demon pit answers to when it says it wants to be human.

claims.text: In a dream realm, beastmen Gu Immortals’ taunts wake a black giant among a mountain of corpses; the giant insists its name is Zuo Ye Hui and goes back to eating. Fang Yuan reads its aura as that of a rank eight peak Gu Immortal, and thinks it seems to be a man and an immemorial desolate beast at the same time. Elsewhere, at Southern Border’s black demon pit, Purple Mountain True Monarch asks a voice from within the pit whether it has always wanted to be human, addressing it as Zuo Ye Hui; the voice names itself Zuo Ye Hui in answer, says it wants to be human and must return the favor, then asks what help is needed.

It appears as a giant seven to eight stories tall, black in color, its black hair flowing like a cape down to its waist with two bright red spots hidden in the hair. It stretches out its arms and stuffs corpses from a mountain-like pile into its mouth with monstrous hands.

Fang Yuan’s heart shakes at the name. Narration places Zuo Ye Hui and You Tian Guang side by side as nightmares of the Olden, Medieval, and Late Antiquity Eras, calls them legendary immemorial desolate beasts, and says they possess human forms for reasons nobody knows. Paradise Earth Immortal Venerable located their hiding spot and fought them; You Tian Guang died and Zuo Ye Hui escaped heavily injured and went missing, with nobody knowing whether it is dead or alive. In the dream realm the giant eats the mountain of corpses with an immortal killer move, and tells the beastman Gu Immortals it wants to eat more humans because the more humans it eats, the closer it is to becoming human. A four elements formation holds it with its lower body buried in the ground, and when it roars and unleashes the immortal killer move grey night, the formation’s earth, water, wind, and fire lights confine the grey light to the valley.

It is a powerful existence on par with rank eight Gu Immortals, and its immortal killer move grey night rips the righteous path super Gu formation’s third layer half apart without breaking through it. Fang Yuan sees it left panting on the spot in exhaustion after that cast, and Ba De calls two casts of grey night its limit. Southern Border’s righteous path super clans hold accurate information about it from their historical records.
Its attack is what originally damaged the earth path Immortal Gu that later breaks as one of the four main pillar Immortal Gu in the super Gu formation’s second layer.

Purple Mountain True Monarch arms it under a prior agreement with Immortal Gu and immortal killer moves, and it survives two hits of Heaven Overseeing Tower’s fate vanquish, standing up after the first with half its injuries healed and after the second still full of vitality.

It knows that its size and its liking for moving fast leave it highly restricted on this battlefield, and Heaven Overseeing Tower carries an aura it detests, so it holds a deep desire to destroy the tower.

An immortal killer move heals its broken bones and tendons almost instantly, and from a distance its food path killer move bites two Central Continent rank eight Gu Immortals, wounding their organs without it approaching them.
Deadlocked with Heaven Overseeing Tower and both sides injured, its incredible recovery speed still leaves it covered in wounds.
